merge_base_sha.description: Git merge-base commit for three-way compare

tonic_repo_profile.description: Snapshot of .tonic/repo.json when emitted via merge-tonic repo compare

marker_branch.description: Branch pushed by the agent with Tonic marker file contents (when markers_present).

marker_branch_commit.description: Commit SHA of the marker snapshot on marker_branch.

marker_paths.description: Repo paths updated on marker_branch with annotated Tonic text.

merge_report_artifact_name.description: Suggested workflow artifact filename for this JSON (e.g. merge-tonic-report.json).

ast_hydration.description: Optional ast-grep or full hydrate pipeline summary when the GitHub agent ran merge-tonic.

left_commit_id.description: Optional left snapshot commit id used for provenance summaries.

right_commit_id.description: Optional right snapshot commit id used for provenance summaries.

conflict_base_kind.description: Normalized base kind parsed from conflict_kind (e.g. git merge).

conflict_tags.description: Key=value tags from Tonic marker labels. Git-merge hydration uses author, intent on the left segment and author_right, intent_right on the right segment.

marker_label_begin.description: Full label after <<<<<<< begin when it differs from conflict_kind-derived text (per-side author/intent).

marker_label_mid.description: Full label after ======= begin when it differs from the begin label.

left_commit_ids.description: Optional left-side commit ids associated with this conflict region.

right_commit_ids.description: Optional right-side commit ids associated with this conflict region.

suggested_resolution.description: Optional newline-preserving resolved hunk for tooling

unified_diff_hint.description: Optional unified diff excerpt for UI

annotated_lines.description: Full Tonic marker text per file; agents embed this for files with markers_present even at medium PR verbosity.
